correctness.rationale: A fixed proper h-arc subset of a directed k-cycle consists of disjoint directed paths, which collapse to n−h ordered blocks; the probability of all arcs in one uniform successor path is (n−h)!/n!=1/(n)_h. A complete directed cycle in a single path has probability zero, requiring truncation at k−1. One avoidance and one union inclusion-exclusion prove the exact finite-k expectation including k=n and r=1. For vertex-disjoint cycles of total L edges, color each required arc by one of r paths: every assignment is feasible except a monochromatic cycle. Their (∏_i(r^{k_i}−r)) n^−L leading probability has O(n^−L−1) overlaps from arcs assigned to more than one path. Overlapping distinct cycles have strictly more distinct arcs than vertices per multicyle component, making their total factorial-moment contribution O(n^−1). Thus each fixed mixed factorial moment tends to that of independent Poisson((r^k−r)/k), giving joint weak convergence and the directed girth law. Scope is fixed r and finite K; finite n is not Poisson.

value.rationale: A union of naturally sampled linear-order successors can have directed cycles despite each constituent being globally acyclic; the exact Poisson means measure the nontrivial deficit r/k relative to independent sparse arcs, and yield directed girth and non-zero-one limiting first-order cycle events. This is a meaningful structural random-finite-model statistic, not a tiny special-case count.

final_claim: For the simple directed union of r iid uniform successor paths on n labeled vertices, the expected directed k-cycle count has an exact two-stage inclusion-exclusion formula, and for fixed r,K all short-cycle counts jointly converge to independent Poisson variables of means (r^k−r)/k.
limitations: Directed k-cycles count rotation classes, not reversal classes, with k≥2. Uniform independent Hamiltonian paths have no closing arc, and duplicate directed edges are collapsed. Joint asymptotic only for fixed number r of paths and fixed finite K of lengths, not all first-order sentences.
residual_risks: An unindexed Poisson approximation theorem for conditioned Hamiltonian path superpositions may imply the same law.
